request.spec:
A person with a hold in force on the sheet's today (a hold whose dates include today) gets no cut
from any pool, and their share is spread over the other members with a cut in proportion to those
members' shares: each member's cut is the pot times their share divided by the shares of the members
with a cut, added up, rounded half to even, with the remainder to the largest share as before (when
no member is left with a cut, each shows 0.00). The pool's total share and balance are unchanged by
the hold.

agent.result_text:
A person whose hold covers the sheet's today now gets no cut from any pool, and their share is spread over the members who still get one. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

The pool's total share and balance don't change. In the test's 50/30/20 pool with a pot of 10.00, holding the 30% member gives 7.14 / 0.00 / 2.86. When nobody is left with a cut, everyone shows 0.00. A hold that has ended or hasn't started yet makes no difference, as the request says.

The change is all on the server, in `pool/`:
- **`PoolRepository.members(sheetId, today)`**: now marks each person as held when one of their holds covers the sheet's today.
- **`PoolMember`**: has a new `held` flag. `SavePoolMember` fills it in from the person's holds.
- **`PoolResponse` cut calculation**: a member gets a cut only if they are neither retired nor held. Each cut is the pot times their share divided by the shares of the members with a cut, added up, and rounded half to even. The rounding remainder goes to the largest share among those members.
- **`RespondWithPools`**: passes the sheet's today in. On an as-of view, that is the as-of date.

On the front end I only updated the doc comment in `pools.ts`. The person and sheet cut totals add up the server's cuts, so they pick up the change without further edits.

One edge case the request doesn't cover: if the only members left with a cut all have a 0.00 share, they all get 0.00 and the pot goes undistributed. The rule doesn't say what should happen there, so I chose that over handing the whole pot to a 0% member.
